column1: # ZAP rules for the scans of examples/demo (.github/workflows/security.yml).
# Format: rule id <TAB> IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL <TAB> (name — reason). Unlisted rules stay WARN:
# reported in the uploaded report, not failing the job. FAIL is reserved for what an auth library
# must never ship: weak cookies, missing protective headers, injection and XSS.

column3: (Cookie Without Secure Flag — the CI scan runs over plain http; Secure follows an https APP_URL / TLS)
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration — Access-Control-Allow-Origin * on the public OAuth/OIDC discovery documents, by design (browser-based clients read them))
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens — the demo's HTML forms are crawler fodder; the library's endpoints take JSON and check Origin + a double-submit header)
(Sensitive Information in URL — a magic/verify link carries its single-use token in the URL by design (short-lived, hashed at rest))
